member.name: M:HotelApi.Services.Documentos.Dni
member.remarks:
Pattern:
^\\d{8}$
Explanation:
○ Match if at the beginning of the string.
○ Match a Unicode digit exactly 8 times.
○ Match if at the end of the string or if before an ending newline.

member.name: M:HotelApi.Services.Documentos.Ce
member.remarks:
Pattern:
^[A-Za-z0-9]{9,12}$
Explanation:
○ Match if at the beginning of the string.
○ Match a character in the set [0-9A-Za-z] atomically at least 9 and at most 12 times.
○ Match if at the end of the string or if before an ending newline.

member.name: M:HotelApi.Services.Documentos.Pasaporte
member.remarks:
Pattern:
^[A-Za-z0-9]{6,12}$
Explanation:
○ Match if at the beginning of the string.
○ Match a character in the set [0-9A-Za-z] atomically at least 6 and at most 12 times.
○ Match if at the end of the string or if before an ending newline.

member.name: M:HotelApi.Services.Documentos.Ruc
member.remarks:
Pattern:
^(10|15|17|20)\\d{9}$
Explanation:
○ Match if at the beginning of the string.
○ 1st capture group.
○ Match with 2 alternative expressions.
○ Match a sequence of expressions.
○ Match '1'.
○ Match a character in the set [057].
○ Match the string "20".
○ Match a Unicode digit exactly 9 times.
○ Match if at the end of the string or if before an ending newline.
